beats.text: A person in Iceland uses 16,248 kg of oil equivalent. South Sudan uses 63.
Iceland has the world's highest energy use, far above the median country.
Qatar is second on the globe at 15,155 kg per person.
In North America, Canada uses 7,119 kg per resident, while USA uses 6,454.
China uses 2,947 kg, counting primary energy before transformation into other fuels.
Near the bottom, Nigeria uses 317 kg, far below the global median.
How much energy does your country use?
